As with all our carbon parts, we use a clear plastic coating that not only improves the appearance, but also protects the carbon fibre from scratching and has a unique UV resistance.

name: Ilmberger Carbon Fiber Winglet Kit For BMW S1000RR 2019-22
source_title: Ilmberger Carbon Fiber Winglet Kit For BMW S1000RR 2019-22
description: The winglet kit for the S1000RR K67 from 2019 also allows the use of our M wings on the S model, with all the advantages…
source_description_html:
The winglet kit for the S1000RR K67 from 2019 also allows the use of our M wings on the S model, with all the advantages and without restrictions. For the first time, the striking M look with certified quality and ABE can also be used on the S. The kit also contains reinforcements for the inside of the fairing, so that the original side fairings can be used!
 
Notes on assembly:
- In addition to the winglets, the Winlgetkit also contains a drilling template for the original side panel parts. These must be drilled using the template to mount the winglets.
 
Notes on use with other Ilmberger Carbon products:
- With the Ilmberger carbon side panels of the M1000RR (VEL.003.M121S.K / VER.004.M121S.K), the holes required for assembly are already integrated, so that they no longer have to be drilled separately
- The supplied reinforcements for the inside of the fairing are not required for the Ilmberger Carbon side fairings (VEL.003.M121S.K / VER.004.M121S.K), due to their enormous strength.
 
In order to obtain a particularly harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted into the mold and aligned by experts. The carbon part nestles perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and aerospace. The material, which is laboriously laminated by hand and hardened in several stages in an autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance, but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has three times the specific stiffness of steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight. These properties are particularly pronounced with us due to the high fiber volume content.
In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer in the world to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear coat, this ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which particularly emphasizes the high quality of the material.
 
The facts:
 
- With ABE
- With drilling template for quick and easy installation
- Noticeable improvement in the aerodynamics of the motorcycle
- The original coloring of the motorcycle is retained
- Sealing of all surfaces (inside and outside) with a unique plastic coating to protect against environmental influences of any kind
- Additional high-gloss clear coat finish on all visible surfaces
- optimally protected against UV light
- Supplied in ready-to-install condition
- TÜV certified quality
- made of prepreg material specially produced for Ilmberger
- Manufactured in-house according to ISO 9001

source_title: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Clutch Cover for BMW M 1000 RR
description: This part is a protective carbon piece and is mounted directly on top of the original component. For the mounting only original screwpoints are used.…
source_description_html:
This part is a protective carbon piece and is mounted directly on top of the original component. For the mounting only original screwpoints are used. The part comes in a very durable version and not only protects the original cover, but also, due to its unique shape, the endangered clutch release bearing on the bottom of the cover.

 

In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

description: The swingarm cover left BMW M 1000 RR Strasse 2021 protects the swingarm from stone chips and other environmental influences. The integrated chain fin was…
source_description_html:
The swingarm cover left BMW M 1000 RR Strasse 2021 protects the swingarm from stone chips and other environmental influences. The integrated chain fin was derived directly from racing and prevents body parts from accidentally getting between the chain and chainring
 
In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

name: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Clutch Cover for BMW S1000RR 2019-22
source_title: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Clutch Cover for BMW S1000RR 2019-22
description: This part is a protective carbon piece and is mounted directly on top of the original component. For the mounting only original screwpoints are used.…
source_description_html:
This part is a protective carbon piece and is mounted directly on top of the original component. For the mounting only original screwpoints are used. The part comes in a very durable version and not only protects the original cover, but also, due to its unique shape, the endangered clutch release bearing on the bottom of the cover.

In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

source_description_html:
When the latest high-tech materials meet modern designs, the result is often overwhelming. And the extended front fender made of carbon is not only visually impressive. Thanks to the latest technology in the field of powder coating, it is optimally protected against all common environmental influences. Thanks to its optimized shape, it also protects the water cooler behind it. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. Without additional screws, the carbon swingarm cover protects everything underneath. The stepless chain tensioner remains free and optimal maintenance of the motorcycle is guaranteed. Thanks to the depth effect of carbon, the swing arm cover looks much more intense than the rough cast surface of the swing arm. 
Installed in just a few minutes, the value of the motorcycle is increased enormously. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.

The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

description: First Wingletkit with ABE for the Ducati V2. They are specially designed and developed for this Bike. In order to fit properly, we recommend the…
source_description_html:
First Wingletkit with ABE for the Ducati V2. They are specially designed and developed for this Bike. In order to fit properly, we recommend the usage of our Ilmberger Carbon Side Fairings for the Winglets. 
 
Winglets on a Motorcycle noticeably improve handling. The pressure on the front wheel is increased, the motorcycle is more stable during acceleration and deceleration. This gives the bike an extra aggressively look an also enhances the driving.​

Notes on assembly:
- In addition to the winglets, the Winlgetkit also contains a drilling template for the original side panel parts. These must be drilled using the template to mount the winglets on the original side faring.
 
Notes on use with other Ilmberger Carbon products:
- With the Ilmberger carbon side panels witht the article number VEL.008.V220G.K and hte VER.009.V220G.K the holes required for assembly are already integrated, so that they no longer have to be drilled separately
 
In order to obtain a particularly harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted into the mold and aligned by experts. The carbon part nestles perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and aerospace. The material, which is laboriously laminated by hand and hardened in several stages in an autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance, but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has three times the specific stiffness of steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight. These properties are particularly pronounced with us due to the high fiber volume content.
In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer in the world to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear coat, this ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which particularly emphasizes the high quality of the material.

name: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Left Frame Cover For Aprilia RSV4 2021-22
source_title: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Left Frame Cover For Aprilia RSV4 2021-22
description: The carbon frame cover is attached directly to the frame. It covers the frame and attracts attention. The frame cover is not only convincing visually.…
source_description_html:
The carbon frame cover is attached directly to the frame. It covers the frame and attracts attention. The frame cover is not only convincing visually. Thanks to the high surface quality of Ilmberger Carbon, the frame cover can withstand intensive use over a long period of time. This means that there are no unpleasant work marks on the rough cast surface of the frame either after countless long tours or during daily use of the motorcycle. In order to perfect the high-quality impression, the frame cover not only runs along the vertical frame strut, where the leg rubs, but also extends far upwards, where it disappears under the tight side cover. It is therefore difficult to see from the outside where the frame cover begins and where it ends.
Installed in just a few minutes, the value of the motorcycle is increased enormously. In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

The sprocket cover is one of the most underrated components on the whole motorcycle. Installed centrally on the motorcycle, it surrounds the chain sprocket and does more than it might seem at first glance. It protects the engine and many other components from flying grease while driving. This is particularly stubborn as dirt and difficult to remove from the soft surface of the original part. A hard surface, as it occurs with high-quality carbon, is more suitable here.
The component can utilize its full potential not only technically, but also optically. Installed in just a few minutes, the value of the motorcycle is increased enormously. In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

name: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Numberplate Holder For Aprilia RSV4 2021-22
source_title: Ilmberger Carbon Fibre Numberplate Holder For Aprilia RSV4 2021-22
description: The numberplate holder in gloss in carbonfiber for the Aprilia RSV4 2021 is not only significantly more subtle and of higher quality in its design…
source_description_html:
The numberplate holder in gloss in carbonfiber for the Aprilia RSV4 2021 is not only significantly more subtle and of higher quality in its design - it also offers enormous advantages from a technical point of view. The use of carbon of the highest quality enables a significant increase in stiffness while at the same time reducing weight enormously.
Improvements compared to the original have also been made in the design. Almost invisible, but still easily accessible, there is an adjustment option for the license plate angle hidden on the inside. In this way, it can be ensured that the license plate is at the legally permitted angle to the road, even with a wide variety of loads and conditions
In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result. The original Suitcases maintain on the bike and can be used es normal.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

description: The carbon frame cover is attached directly to the frame. It covers the frame and attracts attention. The frame cover is not only convincing visually.…
source_description_html:
The carbon frame cover is attached directly to the frame. It covers the frame and attracts attention. The frame cover is not only convincing visually. Thanks to the high surface quality of Ilmberger Carbon, the frame cover can withstand intensive use over a long period of time. This means that there are no unpleasant work marks on the rough cast surface of the frame either after countless long tours or during daily use of the motorcycle. In order to perfect the high-quality impression, the frame cover not only runs along the vertical frame strut, where the leg rubs, but also extends far upwards, where it disappears under the tight side cover. It is therefore difficult to see from the outside where the frame cover begins and where it ends.
Installed in just a few minutes, the value of the motorcycle is increased enormously. In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

Without additional screws, the carbon swingarm cover protects everything underneath. The stepless chain tensioner remains free and optimal maintenance of the motorcycle is guaranteed. Thanks to the depth effect of carbon, the swing arm cover looks much more intense than the rough cast surface of the swing arm. 
Installed in just a few minutes, the value of the motorcycle is increased enormously. In order to obtain a harmonious overall picture, the fiber layers are inserted and aligned in the mold by experts. The carbon part fits perfectly into the surrounding shapes of the motorcycle. The more of our parts are installed and combined, the more overwhelming the result.
For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.
 In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

Of course, the airventcover can also be mounted separate, so without Ilmbergers optional frame cover (article number RAL.016.CBR17.K).

The frame cover(left side) in our unique design for the Honda CBR 1000 RR Fireblade 2017 blends into the motorcycle's overall appearance. The Ilmberger frame cover has cut outs for all openings in the frame, which are necessary for repair and maintenance. Also the little covers on the main frame are cut out on the Ilmberger Carbon frame cover - and of course Ilmberger also offers these little covers in carbon with the article number VEL.013.CBR17.K.  The very complex  cover for the main frame protects the frame from the steering head till the undertray of the main frame. For an easy mounting of the part, Ilmberger has already placed self adhesive strips inside the carbon part, that keep the part safely on the frame.

This part contributes mainly to weight saving on the motorcycle (up to 70% less, compared to other materials) and a high stiffness of the part. Like all of our carbon fibre parts, it was made according to the latest protocols and industry standards and can be considered to encompass all aspects of current 'best of industry' practice. The part is made completely out of pre-preg carbon fibre materials using an autoclave. As with all our carbon parts, we use a clear plastic coating that not only improves the appearance, but also protects the carbon fibre from scratching and has a unique UV resistance.

Ilmberger offers the highest quality and innovation

Ilmberger stands for the highest quality and innovation in carbon fiber manufacturing. Every part is manufactured in our own production facility, using a prepreg specially developed for Ilmberger as the base material. This is processed in a complex autoclave procedure, which offers numerous advantages.

Prepreg, a pre-impregnated carbon fiber fabric, is characterized by a uniform resin distribution combined with a high fiber volume content. This results in maximum strength and increased flexibility of the components. Processing in an autoclave ensures perfect, uniform curing and a flawless surface. This method prevents air inclusions in the material and guarantees consistently high-quality parts.

Our carbon fiber parts are laminated by hand with great expertise and care, ensuring consistent fiber alignment without distortion. After curing in an autoclave, the edges of the parts are precisely cut by robot to guarantee a perfect fit and the highest quality.

A globally unique step in Ilmberger's production process is the complete powder coating of all carbon fiber parts. This coating not only protects the parts from environmental influences but also gives them an unparalleled depth of color. No other carbon fiber manufacturer offers this type of sealing, which prevents the parts from aging and significantly extends their lifespan.

The final clear coat is high-gloss and ensures a perfectly smooth surface, further emphasizing the luxurious yet sporty look of our carbon fiber parts. Every part that leaves our production facility is a masterpiece of engineering and design that meets the highest standards.

Ilmberger: A recognized manufacturer for the highest demands

Ilmberger is not only a leading manufacturer of carbon fiber parts for the aftermarket, but also a recognized OEM supplier for renowned manufacturers such as Ducati and BMW. source_description_html:
The windshield from Ilmberger Carbon gives the driver a little wind protection and takes the strain off the driver's arms while driving. Premature fatigue is counteracted. Visually, the windshield remains discreet and integrates into the design language of the muscle bike. A special highlight is the multi-layer construction, which allows for a beautiful surface – inside and out!
The final clear coat comes in the timeless glossy version and underlines the sporty appearance of the motorcycle!

For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.

In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.
 
The facts

- street legal with german ABE
- Sealing of all surfaces (inside and outside) through a unique plastic coating to protect against environmental influences of any kind and optimal primer for the additional clear coat
- additional clear varnish on all visible surfaces for a uniquely smooth surface - Thanks to multi-layer protection against UV light, no aging processes in the material
- Delivered ready to install
- TÜV certified quality
- Made from prepreg material specially produced for Ilmberger
- Manufactured in-house according to ISO 9001

The huge rear tire of the Ducati Diavel V4 is one of the trademarks of the muscle bike. It is therefore important to integrate this into the rest of the vehicle. The rear fender from Ilmberger Carbon not only offers excellent splash protection, but also fits seamlessly into the design language of the Ducati Diavel V4 and brings the motorcycle to perfection!
The final clear coat comes in the timeless glossy version and underlines the sporty appearance of the motorcycle!

For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.

So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

- street legal with german ABE

- additional clear varnish on all visible surfaces for a uniquely smooth surface - Thanks to multi-layer protection against UV light, no aging processes in the material
- Delivered ready to install
- TÜV certified quality

source_description_html:
The exhaust cover for the Ducati Diavel V4 protects the muffler and gives the standard exhaust a completely new, sporty appearance. The carbon part covers the full height of the muffler and cuts a good figure even when the motorcycle is standing on the side stand!
The final clear coat comes in the timeless glossy version and underlines the sporty appearance of the motorcycle!

For our carbon we only use prepreg fabric specially produced for this purpose, which is also used in a similar form in Formula 1 and space travel. The material, which is elaborately hand-laminated and cured in several stages in the autoclave, not only impresses with its unique appearance but also with its unique technical properties. With the same volume, it has a specific stiffness three times as high as steel and at the same time, due to its particularly low density, only a fraction of its weight.

In order to optimally protect this high-quality material from all kinds of environmental influences, we are the only carbon manufacturer worldwide to use a specially developed plastic coating on all surfaces. In combination with our clear varnish. This ensures a previously unattainable and unique depth effect, which allows the high quality of the material to come into its own.
So that not only driving but also screwing is a pleasure, we only use the original fastening points for this part.

- street legal with german ABE
- Sealing of all surfaces (inside and outside) through a unique plastic coating to protect against environmental influences of any kind and optimal primer for the additional clear coat
- additional clear varnish on all visible surfaces for a uniquely smooth surface - Thanks to multi-layer protection against UV light, no aging processes in theIlmberger material
- Delivered ready to install
- TÜV certified quality
- Made from prepreg material specially produced for Ilmberger
- Manufactured in-house according to ISO 9001
